article_title: A browser-based seismic data observatory for detecting and comparing earthquake sequences across North American catalogues
figure_behavior: Fixed figures; explorer filtering does not recalculate or modify these images.
image_transformations: None: byte-identical copies of the manuscript PNGs.
data_attribution: SSN, Institute of Geophysics, UNAM; USGS ComCat and contributing networks. Original provider attribution and rights remain applicable.
interpretation: Operational families are not physical triggering truth; cross-catalogue pairs remain candidates. Reported magnitudes are not converted to a common physical scale.

assets.scope: Anchored operational families for 2017 and 2022; native reported M>=4.5; fixed source-specific development thresholds.
Retained magnitude distributions, weighted time-distance proximities, and candidate-pair reported-magnitude differences.
Computational scaling on the complete retained SSN reported-M>=3.5 input; machine-specific measured timings.
